sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that learned trial court has erred in convicting and sentencing the applicant as [2024:RJ-JP:42565] (2 of 4) [SOSA-941/2023] mentioned above.
Learned trial court has not appreciated the evidence in right and correct perspective.

He further submits that a typed report was submitted by mother of the victim in presence of victim to the SHO,
P.S. Mahila Thana, Bhiwadi on which FIR was registered.
In written report, allegation of commission of rape was levelled against two persons only and appellant was not named in it.

It is further submitted that later on, she slightly changed her version and instead of naming two persons,
who are mentioned in the FIR

, she stated that two persons and one Tara, who is uncle of victim,
committed rape upon her.

It is further submitted that in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., appellant was not named, therefore, on this ground and other evidences which were collected during the course of investigation, police reached the conclusion that appellant was not involved in the alleged incident and filed charge-sheet against two persons, namely - Rajesh and Harjot.

It is further submitted that during the course of trial, victim was examined and she levelled allegation of rape against appellant, therefore, he was summoned as an additional accused under the provisions of Section 319 Cr.P.C.
It is further submitted that during the course of trial, victim was found major.
Learned counsel contends that appellant was on bail during trial and there is no allegation against him of misusing the liberty of bail.
It is further contended that appellant has suffered incarceration of more than one year.
There is no immediate prospect of this appeal being heard and disposed of in near future and hearing of the appeal will take time.

4. Learned Public Prosecutor opposes the submissions made by [2024:RJ-JP:42565] (3 of 4)
[SOSA-941/2023] the learned counsel for appellant.

5. Upon a consideration of the arguments advanced on behalf of the appellant and having regard to the facts and circumstances as available on the record especially the fact that no allegation was levelled against the appellant in the typed report, thereafter, in her statement which was recorded under Section 161 & 164 Cr.P.C, no allegation of rape was levelled against the appellant and in the investigation, no role of appellant was found and he was summoned as an additional accused under the provisions of Section 319 Cr.P.C., but without making any comment on the merits/demerits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case for suspending the sentences awarded to the accused appellant during pendency of the instant appeal.

6. Accordingly, the application for suspension of sentence filed under Section 389 of Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the sentences passed by learned Special Judge, POCSO Act, 2012 and Child Right Commission Act, 2005, No.1, Alwar vide judgment dated 02.06.2023 in Sessions Case No.40/2020 against the appellant-applicant Kala @ Kaliya Son Of Dhansingh, shall remain suspended till final disposal of the aforesaid appeal and he shall be released on bail, provided he executes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance in this court on 08.11.2024 and whenever ordered to do so till the disposal of the appeal on the conditions indicated below:-
